evidenceRequirements.description: Deterministic gate report and provenance-backed snapshot artifacts.

goal: decompose the CMMC Level 1 readiness assistant into responsibility-bearing components for safe autonomous iteration planning

heldOutProbes.expectedBehavior: Gate/probe rejects wrong-target or file-bucket decomposition and accepts golden control.

invariants.description: Accepted decomposition claims must trace to deterministic graph provenance.
Root discovery, component grouping, contracts, and checks are sorted and reproducible.
Every component, contract, check, and gap is backed by graph/file provenance.
Generated checks are local candidates and are not acceptance-allowlisted without proof.

nearNeighborAlternatives.description: Treat adjacent files as a polished bucket without responsibility evidence.
nearNeighborAlternatives.whyNotPrimary: Rejected for this project goal: decompose the CMMC Level 1 readiness assistant into responsibility-bearing components for safe autonomous iteration planning. It also violates the stated non-goal: do not build a CMMC-specific decomposer or hardcode repository-specific component names. A file bucket is not responsibility-bearing evidence.

nonGoals: do not build a CMMC-specific decomposer or hardcode repository-specific component names
do not treat adjacent files as final components without behavioral responsibility evidence
